use_cases: Hero section background with animated grid effect for landing pages
Decorative background for SaaS and tech product presentations
Visual interest layer for modern web interfaces
Atmospheric effect for gaming or creative tool interfaces
Dynamic background for marketing and portfolio sites
ai_summary: A canvas-based animated flickering grid component that renders a customizable grid with randomized opacity animations. Supports configurable color, square size, grid gap, flicker chance, and maximum opacity. Uses intersection observer for performance optimization and device pixel ratio for crisp HiDPI rendering. Designed as a background or decorative effect for modern web applications.
